media.title: The City Hall, Los Angeles — Tichnor postcard, c. 1930–1945
media.description: Linen-finish picture postcard of Los Angeles City Hall, completed in 1928, seen across its lawns. It was published by Tichnor Brothers of Boston through its Los Angeles office, the Tichnor Art Company, as card 63743.
media.altText: Coloured postcard of a white stepped tower rising above a long civic building, with lawns and palm trees in front.
media.publicCaption: Los Angeles City Hall, completed in 1928, on a Tichnor postcard of about 1930–1945.
media.publicCreditLine: Tichnor Brothers, Boston (Tichnor Art Company, Los Angeles), card 63743; Boston Public Library, Tichnor Brothers Postcard Collection; via Digital Commonwealth.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. Tichnor Brothers of Boston published the card in the United States between about 1930 and 1945, and neither side carries a copyright notice; a work published in the United States before 1978 without notice entered the public domain on publication. The Boston Public Library, which holds the card, records no known copyright restrictions.

places.publicNote: Los Angeles provides the metropolitan context for Kaper’s Hollywood career after his move to MGM.
